method: One call per edition, drawn from Today's Signal. Graded HIT or MISS on its stated horizon against a primary or tier-1 source, never on vibes. A call that cannot be settled by evidence on its horizon is graded UNSETTLED, not quietly dropped.

calls.call: The consequential AI work in August 2026 is moving from model capability to the governance layer around models: who may call which model, what marks its output must carry, and how the calling protocol survives supply-chain compromise.
calls.basis: Three of four Briefs this edition were governance stories in product clothing: GPT-5.6-Cyber's Daybreak Red licensing gate, the EU AI Act transparency clock, and the MCP stateless spec's OAuth-aligned auth.
calls.test: By 2026-09-13, at least two further gated-access, provenance-marking or protocol-auth developments ship from frontier labs or standards bodies, evidenced by primary sources.
